lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is a special meeting at Telluride Medical Center where the board takes up a proposal to engage Jensen Partners for due diligence with CommonSpirit Health — one of the country's largest hospital systems — a signal that a major affiliation or transaction may be in motion. Alongside that, Ouray City Council holds a public hearing on its 2027 budget and votes on utility rate ordinances, Telluride's Ecology Commission takes up a draft ordinance that would phase out gas-powered lawn equipment in town by 2030, and Mountainfilm for Locals runs Monday and Tuesday for those who haven't caught it yet.

notable.stake: Board votes on due diligence engagement with major hospital system CommonSpirit Health.
Public hearing on Ouray's 2027 budget; council votes on utility rate ordinances.
